description: Apply the SysMLValidation constraints, and those of any rule packages named, reflectively to every element of a model (the SelfCheck RPC, the CLI's -self-check and -self-check-package): each element is handed to every constraint whose input its metaclass conforms to. `status` is holds, fails or unresolved; `findings` carry each violation, evaluation the runtime could not make, error and skipped rule constraint with the element's location and the line the CLI prints; the counts and `applications` say how much was checked. The result is the SelfCheckResponse as protojson writes it.

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

selfCheckPackage.description: qualified names of packages whose constraint definitions apply after the bundled SysMLValidation ones (-self-check-package); each must be a package the model or its libraries declare

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: self_check
